subject: Pilot materials: prompt pack delivery, gated testcases & MAP timeline
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia@nxhealth.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot: Request to exchange prompt pack & gated testcases

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — NexusHealth AI is excited to move forward with a 6-week pilot to evaluate Redwood's inference throughput and output quality for our clinical summarization workflows. To run our evaluation harness we need:

- A copy of your curated prompt pack (preferably with example signal/labels)
- A small set (~200) of gated test cases (PHI-sanitized) under a limited-use evaluation license

We can sign a short MAP that covers milestones and a minimal data handling addendum (retention and non-redistribution). Can your team share the prompt pack and a draft license that limits use to the pilot and prohibits redistribution?

I'll attach our standard vendor questionnaire and a proposed MAP timeline for review.

Thanks,
Olivia
Director of ML Engineering
NexusHealth AI
Attachments: nexus_vendor_q.pdf (pdf), nexus_map_proposal.docx (docx)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@nxhealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: Request to exchange prompt pack & gated testcases

Hi Olivia — great to hear. We're aligned on a short MAP. High-level:

Milestones (proposal)
- Week 0: NDA signed + MAP agreed
- Week 1: Prompt pack + testcases delivered (gated)
- Week 2–4: Customer runs evaluation harness; syncs weekly
- Week 5: Quality review + remediation notes
- Week 6: Close/decision meeting

On the data/license side we typically share a prompt pack archive and a "limited evaluation license" PDF that explicitly prohibits redistribution, further sub-licensing, and requires deletion after the pilot window unless otherwise agreed. We also require an auditable retention window and minimal logging for troubleshooting (token-level logs only, retained for 30 days unless you request longer).

I'll attach the prompt pack (redacted examples) and our standard evaluation license for review. Please note: gated testcases will be delivered as a checksum-locked CSV and only accessible to named Nexus engineers listed in the MAP. If you need access for more users, we can add them to the MAP prior to delivery.

Proposed timeline: sign NDA by 2026-10-25, delivery by 2026-10-29, evaluation complete by 2026-11-12, decision by 2026-11-15.

Thanks — looping in Ben for procurement questions.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_promptpack_v1.zip (zip), redwood_evaluation_license_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-21 11:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: Request to exchange prompt pack & gated testcases — license redlines

Kim / Ben — quick notes on the license and delivery constraints from an ops/infra perspective: 

1) Allowed use (tight): evaluation of Redwood inference solely for the Nexus pilot described in the MAP. No production use permitted.
2) Prohibited: redistribution of prompt pack or testcases, rehosting the prompt pack as part of any external service, or using testcases to finetune models outside of the pilot (even internally) without express written consent.
3) Access control: delivery via a signed URL with IP allowlist or SSO team account. We require a named-user list in the MAP; audit logs will identify user access.
4) Retention & deletion: Nexus must confirm deletion of the prompt pack and testcases within 14 days after the pilot close date (unless extended in writing).
5) Reporting: Nexus agrees to share aggregate evaluation metrics and any failure cases that materially impact safety/PHI handling so we can triage.

Ben — procurement will want a short redline to the eval license (one page) emphasizing the non-redistribution clause and the 14-day deletion requirement. Dev — can you confirm that delivery via signed S3 URL with expiring tokens and access logs is okay?

Marissa
Director, Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Kim / team,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for sharing the prompt pack and draft license. Procurement has signed the NDA — attached. A couple quick confirmations:

- We accept the limited evaluation license with the non-redistribution and 14-day deletion clause.
- Delivery method (signed S3 URL + IP allowlist) works for us; we'll provide the named-user list by EOD Friday (2026-11-05).
- We'll share aggregate evaluation metrics and a short anonymized failure log as requested.

Next steps:
1) Redwood to upload prompt pack + gated testcases to signed URL by 2026-11-04.
2) Nexus to run evaluation and send weekly status updates (first update 2026-11-11).
3) Decision meeting 2026-11-15 to discuss results and any scope for extension.

Attached: Nexus_Signed_NDA.pdf (pdf).

Appreciate the smooth coordination — excited to get started.

Best,
